effect: Seed dispersal and the renewing forest became a flowering forest, completing the remaining goal and connecting animal feeding to landscape renewal.
reaction: The ending brought the earlier exchanges together satisfyingly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making pollination was most worthwhile: it explained how an insect seeking food can also carry pollen, making the exchange understandable rather than just naming it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting seeds left two possible partners without clarifying which served the remaining goal, so the next choice was still a guess.

surprise.text: Combining seeds with flowers produced fruit; the result made the animal-dispersal route clearer.

arbitrary.text: Seeds plus flowers felt somewhat arbitrary before the fruit result, although the subsequent explanation gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the connected exchanges made the living world feel like more than a collection of organisms, and I would be curious to see what follows.
